title: The Chat button opens the client's chat in a window
text: On a Contact page, clicking Chat now opens that person's Portal Chats in a floating window, right on their chat, with all the chat tools: emoji, scan or photo attach, AI polish and suggestions, voice notes, To-Do and the Worker. The page behind stays where it was. The same happens when you click "Open in chat" in the Activity & to-dos box, on a Contact, a company or a partner page.
points: Clicking Chat again brings the same window to the front instead of opening a second one. Each person gets their own window, titled with their name.
Hold Ctrl or Cmd while clicking Chat to see all portal messages and email threads in one timeline in the page, as before.
On a small screen, or where windows are off, Chat shows the in-page timeline as before.
The window shows the whole Portal Chats screen, opened on that person's own chat. Their companies' chats are one click away in its list.
